japanese-kana.swsh: あいてへの　いらだちを　ぶつけて　こうげき。 そのターンに　のうりょくを　さげられていると わざの　いりょくが　２ばいに　なる。

korean.swsh: 상대에 대한 울분이 담긴 공격을 한다. 그 턴에 능력이 떨어져 있으면 기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 將惱怒砸向對手進行攻擊。 如果此回合已被降低能力， 招式威力就會變成２倍。

french.swsh: Le lanceur frappe l’ennemi avec toute sa rancune. Si les stats du lanceur ont diminué pendant ce tour, la puissance de cette attaque est doublée.

german.swsh: Der Anwender entlädt seinen Frust in einem Angriff. Die Stärke der Attacke wird verdoppelt, wenn seine Statuswerte in dieser Runde gesenkt wurden.

spanish.swsh: Ataca al rival presa de la rabia. Si el usuario ha sufrido una reducción de características en ese turno, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.

italian.swsh: Chi la usa attacca il bersaglio con tutta la propria ira. Se ha subito riduzioni delle statistiche durante quel turno, la potenza della mossa raddoppia.

english.swsh: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.
english.la: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If its stats were lowered during the turn, the power of this move is doubled.
english.sv: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

japanese.swsh: 相手への　いらだちを　ぶつけて　攻撃。 そのターンに　能力を　さげられていると 技の　威力が　２倍に　なる。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 攻击对手以发泄对其感到的恼怒情绪。 如果在该回合内自身能力遭到降低， 招式的威力会变成２倍。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: Ataca al rival presa de la rabia. Si el usuario ha sufrido una reducción de características en ese turno, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.

effect.full: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
effect.shortEffect: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
